mission: Certify deterministic temporal memory and safe NotebookLM query throughput

items.title: Freeze current baseline and private temporal oracle fixtures
items.output: Baseline packet and immutable corpus/query fingerprints
items.stop_condition: Do not begin feature code until current behavior and oracle inputs reproduce

items.title: Approve event, time-range, context-pack, and verification contracts
items.stop_condition: Stop if canonical identity or failure behavior remains ambiguous

items.title: Run ADR spikes for index engine and indexed-content boundary
items.stop_condition: Reject any design duplicating visibility/redaction logic

items.title: Build canonical event extractor and independent slow oracle
items.stop_condition: No progression without exact identity parity

items.title: Build crash-safe incremental temporal index
items.stop_condition: Stop on any partial-commit or oracle mismatch

items.title: Implement DST-safe temporal expression resolver
items.stop_condition: All ambiguous or invalid periods must be explicit

items.title: Measure and choose deterministic activity segmentation
items.stop_condition: Reject thresholds that fragment or merge oracle activities beyond rubric

items.title: Build hierarchical budget-aware context packer
items.output: Context packs with coverage and drill-down
items.stop_condition: No silent omission or unverifiable summary claim

items.title: Create unified local temporal CLI
items.stop_condition: Fresh-user core paths must not require low-level scripts

items.title: Add fresh-task skill routing and cold-start evaluations
items.output: Installed skill guidance and cold-start suite
items.stop_condition: Do not ship if a context-free task routes broad temporal questions to semantic-only search

items.title: Implement exact thread-to-current-source mapping
items.stop_condition: Any missing/stale mapping must degrade explicitly

items.title: Compare local-only and source-scoped temporal synthesis
items.stop_condition: Reject remote route if it adds no measured usefulness

items.title: Build local verifier for temporal NotebookLM claims
items.stop_condition: No accepted remote factual claim without local evidence

items.title: Materialize exhaustive temporal development/validation/holdout suites
items.stop_condition: Do not tune against sealed details

items.title: Expand prompt-packing development benchmark
items.output: Deterministic pack-size 1/2/4/8 structural plan and parser gate
items.stop_condition: Stop size ramp on any per-question quality regression

items.title: Prove or reject non-destructive explicit conversation pools
items.stop_condition: Reject if provisioning deletes or contaminates persistent chat

items.title: Model and dry-run isolated notebook replicas
items.stop_condition: No live replica creation without explicit approval

items.title: Choose safe query-isolation topology
items.stop_condition: Keep sequential/packed mode if no topology passes

items.title: Implement bounded parallel executor
items.output: Isolation-aware executor, limiter, cancellation, circuit breaker
items.stop_condition: No concurrency above one until isolation tests pass

items.title: Run live concurrency ramp 1/2/4/8 then gated 16
items.stop_condition: Stop immediately on cross-talk, quality loss, account warning, or orphan work
items.notes: Prepared but not run; creating isolated replicas mutates external NotebookLM state and requires explicit approval.

items.title: Profile and optimize current, 2x, 5x, and 10x corpus paths
items.stop_condition: Do not trade correctness or architecture clarity for benchmark-only wins

items.title: Execute failure-injection and recovery campaign
items.stop_condition: Any canonical loss or silent success blocks release

items.title: Complete privacy, ACL, retention, and supply-chain audit
items.stop_condition: Any credential/path leak or unsafe ACL blocks release

items.title: Unify doctor, observability, recovery, and operator UX
items.stop_condition: No hidden retry, stale success, visible window, or unbounded log

items.title: Run shadow comparison and one-machine canary
items.stop_condition: Rollback on any P0-P2 or unexplained discrepancy

items.title: Complete seven-day or reset fourteen-day soak
items.stop_condition: Any scheduler/index/concurrency defect resets the soak

items.title: Run fresh sealed holdout and final certification audit
items.stop_condition: Zero waivers for required gates

items.title: Publish protected release and rehearse rollback
items.output: Tag, docs, rollback bundle, recovery proof
items.stop_condition: Do not publish from a dirty or unverified revision

items.title: Run live packed retrieval quality ramp
items.output: Aggregate pack-size quality and latency evidence
items.stop_condition: Do not promote a pack size below the frozen quality threshold
